Ground floor has a wide dark open centered door and a short covered porch, a readable rectangular route/map board on the wall to the right of the door, a small brass message bell. Small stone water trough for creature partners at lower left beside the front wall, kept within the facade footprint. Small plaque with three pale dots above the doorway, no letters or numbers. Crisp native pixel clusters and distinct material planes, muted cottonwood riverbank palette, soft upper-left daylight, grounded and lived in. Whole roof, porch, trough and foundation within the image with at least 6 transparent pixels on all sides. Flat rectangular footprint, no surrounding grass, no extra people, no checkerboard.
